Test method: Sequentially run scripts to create and delete VLANs from 1 to 4000 (start the next round of loop when prompted that commands can be entered), continuously send and receive packets, repeat this process for ten rounds each. If the device remains operational, it is considered stable. Record the memory occupancy after the execution is completed.
For our device, when the stress - testing quantity reaches over 2000, high - frequency creation and deletion may cause problems such as the device getting stuck or processes being terminated. If this performance issue cannot be resolved, it is recommended to increase the time for the next command - line to jump out, and wait until the creation is completed before executing other commands.
